title: Tamas Fulop Bassist

about.title: About Me
about.text01:
I started playing drums in 2015 and continued until 2020. In 2018 we founded the band Moonshiners, which focused on rock and blues covers. Through regular rehearsals, I developed my sense of rhythm and timing, as well as my experience in playing in a band. In 2024 I began playing bass guitar, building on this foundation.

Here are some selections from our band’s repertoire:

about.figcaption02: P.Box - A zöld a bíbor és a fekete <small>(Cover - rehearsal demo)</small>
about.text02: More demo recordings from the repertoire of the now-disbanded Moonshiners band.

portfolio.title: Music Portfolio
portfolio.text:
I started learning bass guitar as an autodidact, and since then I have been continuously developing my playing skills. My playing style is mainly built around groovy, danceable songs where the groove and rhythmic foundation of the bass play a particularly important role. I choose and learn songs where the bass supports the music in a creative yet supportive way.

The purpose of this portfolio is to present my musical direction and my development as a bass player, as well as to help me find a place in the future as a bassist in a band with a similar musical style.
portfolio.figcaption01: Queen - Crazy Little Thing Called Love <small>(Bass Cover by eftomi)</small>
portfolio.description01: To me, this song captures the lighthearted spirit and energy of rock and roll. I love the playful bass line and the way the rhythm keeps the music moving. It's a joy to play because it requires both precision and a relaxed feel.
portfolio.figcaption02: James Brown - I Got You (I Feel Good) <small>(Bass Cover by eftomi)</small>
portfolio.description02: What I love most about this song is its funky pulse and the rhythmic role of the bass. I enjoy how seemingly simple patterns come together to create a great groove. When playing it, I focus on keeping the rhythm tight while bringing out the energy that makes this song so special.
portfolio.figcaption03: Chuck Berry - Johnny B. Goode <small>(Bass Cover by eftomi)</small>
portfolio.description03: This is pure, energetic rock and roll that's simply fun to play. The constantly moving bass line and driving tempo keep me fully engaged throughout the song. What I enjoy most is its infectious energy and the sheer joy of playing it.
